body:
BP_APP_CARGO had no case in bigo_phone_input's own switch at all -- SELECT has done nothing since the phone was built. New BP_FX_ITEM_USE/PC_PACKET_ITEM_USE/PcItemUsePacket, pc_try_remove_item_from_inventory. server_smash_cake/server_distraction_active are a faithful port of SHANKPIT's own witness_ai.c functions, halving nearby NPC vigilance for 8s. Re-investigated and found the cake-smash 'blocked on zone landmarks' note was stale -- the real blocker (no live QUIET-observation path) was already fixed by Phase A. 7/7 live scratch-harness assertions, bazel 36/36 green, real server+client builds clean, ASan/UBSan clean. BIG_O/NORTHSTAR.md §20.

⚓ ☃
title: Cake-smash distraction goes live -- Cargo's SELECT finally does something
